name: codex-voice
description: Bind the separate Windows voice companion to the current Codex session.

interface.shortDescription: Connect local voice input to this Codex session.
interface.longDescription: Guides an exact-session binding through the separate Windows companion and helps check its state. The companion handles the microphone and local speech recognition; installing this plugin does not install or start it.
interface.defaultPrompt: Connect the Windows voice companion to this Codex session and check the binding.
